content: TypeBox emits real JSON Schema directly consumable by Ajv/OpenAPI tooling without conversion; Zod emits a Zod-specific internal representation (Zod 4 adds toJSONSchema but it is lossy for refinements). Ajv is roughly 7x faster than Zod on simple object validation (14M vs 2M ops/sec); Zod v4 is ~22x slower than TypeBox in benchmarks. Adoption: Zod ~20M weekly downloads vs TypeBox ~3M (npm, Mar 2026). Guidance found: Ajv for validating config/JSON files at scale; Zod for TS-first app code and ecosystem integration (Astro content collections use Zod natively). Performance is irrelevant for 27 small JSON files - the deciding factors are schema portability to non-TS contributors and integration with Astro's Zod-based collection schemas.
